item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: OCII Commission scheduled to consider authorizing the Block 12 West MOU with FOCIL-MB (about 265 affordable and 270 market-rate units; Resolution No. 23-2026) at its October 6, 2026 meeting. The August 13, 2026 CAC deck had targeted September 2026; the item was not on the September 1 agenda and the September 15 meeting was cancelled. The outcome of the October 6 meeting is not confirmed in any source written after it (see open questions). (Oct 6, 2026)

The outcome of the October 6 meeting is not confirmed in any source written after it (see open questions). (Oct 6, 2026). item.title: Correction · P2: P2 was shown as under construction. Construction has not started: SF Recreation and Park's Mission Creek Park South Extension page gives construction beginning late 2026 or early 2027 and no opening date yet. The walkable part of P2 today is the existing Huffaker Park path and community garden, which the project's schematic design says will be preserved, with the path repaved to city standards. P2 now shows as existing, not yet redeveloped; the expected construction start stays on its timeline.
item.description: P2 was shown as under construction. Construction has not started: SF Recreation and Park's Mission Creek Park South Extension page gives construction beginning late 2026 or early 2027 and no opening date yet. The walkable part of P2 today is the existing Huffaker Park path and community garden, which the project's schematic design says will be preserved, with the path repaved to city standards. P2 now shows as existing, not yet redeveloped; the expected construction start stays on its timeline. Source: https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje.
